name: Sightline
feature_notes: Sightline adds an isolated Carvewright camera trial linked from Ike's shop inbox and Carvewright. Reference-card photo measurement and native ARKit evidence import feed one outlined lettering geometry for preview, SVG and DXF. No routine rack code or board dimension entry. Species and thickness remain unknown; pricing stays conditional and no machine program is generated. An unsigned, uncompiled native companion source project is supplied for device trials. No accounts, live orders or backend changes. See SIGHTLINE_GUIDE.md and SIGHTLINE_NATIVE.md.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Countercraft tables, private storage and exact-vessel gateway verified. TrueFit service v2 deployed; Sea Trial remains enabled only by owner publication.
